record.paper_title: Lower Bounds for Unrestricted Boolean Circuits: Open Problems
record.original_question: For Boolean functions with multiple outputs, can one prove lower bounds that are stronger than the currently known bounds for single-output Boolean functions?

evidence.quote: Can one prove stronger lower bounds for functions with multiple outputs?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider Boolean circuits over the full binary basis $B_2$ (the set of all two-input Boolean functions), with no restrictions on depth, fan-out, or topology. For a Boolean function $f:\{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}^m$, let $C(f)$ denote the minimum number of gates in such a circuit computing $f$. The strongest known explicit lower bound for single-output functions ($m=1$) is of the form $(3+\tfrac{1}{86})n - o(n)$.

Exhibit an explicit family of multi-output Boolean functions $\{f_n:\{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}^{m(n)}\}$ (with $m(n) \ge 2$, e.g., $m(n) = O(n)$) together with a proof that $C(f_n) \ge c \cdot n$ for some constant $c$ strictly larger than the best known constant for single-output functions, or more generally prove a superlinear lower bound on $C(f_n)$ for some explicit multi-output family. Equivalently: can one leverage multiple outputs to obtain circuit-size lower bounds in the unrestricted model that exceed those currently known for single-output Boolean functions?
artifact.status_search_result: Stronger lower bounds for explicit multi-output Boolean functions over the full binary basis are known: a $7n - o(n)$ bound has been established for certain explicit functions in $B_{n,n}$, exceeding the best known $\approx (3+1/86)n$ bound for single-output functions. However, no superlinear lower bound is known for any explicit (multi-output) function in the unrestricted circuit model, so the broader version of the question remains open.

status_evidence.title: New Lower Bounds on Circuit Size of Multi-output Functions
status_evidence.snippet: Lower bound of 7n - o(n) for multi-output Boolean functions in B_{n,n}.
status_evidence.claim: Stronger linear lower bounds (7n-o(n)) are known for explicit multi-output functions than for single-output ones.

status_evidence.title: Lower Bounds for Unrestricted Boolean Circuits: Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of open problems including stronger lower bounds for multi-output functions.
status_evidence.claim: The question of obtaining stronger (in particular superlinear) lower bounds for multi-output functions is listed as an open problem.
